items.title: CLI failures must produce nonzero process exit codes
items.criterion: Every `return 1` in system_check, ingest, create, curate and save_as is replaced by `raise typer.Exit(code=1)`. Tests assert `exit_code == 1` for failure cases such as a missing file or an unreachable server.

items.title: QAGenerator must use client.config so chunk overrides apply
items.criterion: QAGenerator.__init__ uses `client.config` instead of re-reading config from disk, or merges config only once. A test shows that the --chunk-size/--chunk-overlap overrides set in create.process_file reach split_into_chunks.

items.title: Web server file routes must block path traversal
items.criterion: view_file, qa_json, edit_item and delete_item resolve the requested path and reject (4xx) any path outside the data root, including `../` paths. Tests cover a traversal attempt.

items.title: Sanitize uploaded filenames in web upload and ingest routes
items.criterion: The upload and ingest routes pass uploaded filenames through `werkzeug.utils.secure_filename` and reject empty names before saving.

items.title: split_into_chunks must honor the overlap argument
items.criterion: Overlap between consecutive chunks is bounded by the `overlap` parameter, not a hardcoded last 3 sentences, and `overlap=0` yields no overlap. Unit tests check the overlap length.

items.title: split_into_chunks must split paragraphs larger than chunk_size
items.criterion: No chunk exceeds chunk_size except where it cannot be avoided, because oversized paragraphs are split with a sentence, word or character fallback and no text is lost. Tests cover a single huge paragraph and the empty string.

items.title: Remove stray test_write.json written by create qa
items.criterion: process_file for the qa type no longer writes `test_write.json` into the output directory.

items.title: Propagate QA output write failures instead of returning success
items.criterion: Exceptions from writing the QA result are no longer caught and swallowed, so process_file does not return output_path when the write failed.

items.title: Handle bare output filenames without makedirs('') crash
items.criterion: Every `os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path))` call is guarded so it does nothing when dirname is empty, or a shared helper is used. This covers curate, save_as, format_converter and all parser save() methods.

items.title: LLMClient retry settings: handle missing keys and zero values
items.criterion: max_retries and retry_delay are resolved with `is not None` checks and defaults of 3 and 1.0, and invalid values (negative or non-numeric) are rejected. Retry loops raise after exhaustion instead of returning None.

items.title: parse_ratings must not globally unescape \n/\t before json.loads
items.criterion: The `replace('\\n','\n')`-style rewriting of the raw text is removed, and JSON containing escaped sequences inside strings parses correctly. A test covers this.

items.title: Validate parse_qa_pairs output schema
items.criterion: parse_qa_pairs returns only dict items that have string `question` and `answer` fields. When nothing valid is found it falls back or raises, and tests cover dicts, string lists and missing keys.

items.title: rate_qa_pairs average computed over actually rated pairs
items.criterion: avg_score divides total_score by the count of evaluated pairs rather than by len(qa_pairs). A test with a failed or unparsable batch confirms this.

items.title: Reuse one AsyncOpenAI client per batch and close it
items.criterion: _process_message_async no longer constructs a new AsyncOpenAI client per message. A single client is created per batch_completion, or cached, shared across tasks and closed.

items.title: No directory creation at CLI import; honor --config paths
items.criterion: AppContext no longer creates data directories in __init__ at module import. Directories are created in the CLI callback from the config selected with -c, so `--help` has no filesystem side effects.

items.title: YouTube video-id extraction supports shorts, embed and youtu.be?si
items.criterion: The video id is parsed via urllib.parse for watch, youtu.be (stripping the query), /shorts/ and /embed/ URLs. A clear ValueError replaces the AttributeError on `.group` when no id is found.

items.title: Add timeouts to HTTP requests in ingest and parsers
items.criterion: requests.head in _check_pdf_url and requests.get in HTMLParser.parse and PDFParser.parse all pass a timeout argument.

items.title: save_as conversation extraction locates roles, supports wrapped/ShareGPT forms
items.criterion: convert_format finds user and assistant messages by role rather than fixed indices 1 and 2. It handles 2-message conversations, lists of {conversations: [...]} from cot-enhance, and from/value keys, and warns on or rejects malformed items without KeyError.

items.title: to_hf_dataset handles empty input
items.criterion: An empty qa_pairs list produces a clear ValueError or an empty Dataset instead of an IndexError. A unit test covers this.

items.title: Strictly validate cot-enhance input shapes
items.criterion: Format detection requires all items to be dicts, so empty or non-dict lists are not misclassified. Unrecognized shapes, such as a dict without qa_pairs or conversations, raise a descriptive ValueError instead of iterating keys or slicing a dict.

items.title: edit_item/delete_item request validation
items.criterion: The handlers use `get_json(silent=True)` and check fields with `is not None`, so falsy content such as an empty dict is accepted. They require an integer item_index within range and return 400 for invalid input instead of 500.

items.title: Make CI linting actually run
items.criterion: .pre-commit-config.yaml defines real hooks such as ruff, or ci.yml runs ruff check unconditionally rather than only `if: failure()`.

items.title: Remove leaked API key from multimodal notebook
items.criterion: The hardcoded API_ENDPOINT_KEY value in the use-case notebook is replaced by a placeholder, and the executed outputs and counts are reset.

items.title: Parsers return a uniform list of document dicts
items.criterion: The TXT, DOCX, PPT and PDF parsers return `[{"text": ...}]` instead of a raw string. QAGenerator exposes process_documents(documents=...) that consumes this format, and the tests are updated.

items.title: Multimodal ingest to Lance datasets with text and image columns
items.criterion: ingest accepts `--multimodal`, including for directory input via the directory processor, and writes a .lance dataset with text and image columns using a multimodal parser and lance utilities. Tests are added.

items.title: Add multimodal-qa content type to create
items.criterion: create supports `--type multimodal-qa` on .lance input via MultimodalQAGenerator.process_dataset. The output JSON is named from the input base_name rather than a fixed name, and the CLI help lists the type.

items.title: Add vqa content type routed to VQAGenerator
items.criterion: create.process_file handles content_type 'vqa' by calling VQAGenerator.process_dataset with documents, output_dir, num_examples and verbose.

items.title: Curate supports cot_examples input and preserves the CoT format
items.criterion: curate_qa_pairs accepts files containing cot_examples and no qa_pairs: it rates question/answer while keeping reasoning, then writes the filtered cot_examples back. The empty-input error message mentions both formats and the tests are updated.

items.title: Rolling summary option for long documents
items.criterion: QAGenerator.generate_summary accepts rolling_summary. When it is set, the document is split into max_context_length chunks with configurable summary_overlap, each chunk is summarized, and the joined summaries are re-summarized. create.process_file passes the flag through and config.yaml gains summary_overlap.

items.title: Declare pylance and PyMuPDF dependencies
items.criterion: pyproject.toml lists pylance and PyMuPDF in runtime dependencies, not the wrong 'fitz' package, and PyMuPDF in dev extras.

items.title: Normalize and validate numeric ratings
items.criterion: parse_ratings converts ratings to finite floats, for example from the string "8", and skips or rejects booleans, unconvertible values and values outside 1-10. Curation threshold comparison and score sums therefore no longer raise TypeError.

items.title: Use structured JSON extraction in parse_qa_pairs and CoT parse_json_output
items.criterion: Both parsers check fenced code blocks first and use decoder-based extraction instead of greedy first-`[` to last-`]` slicing. Unrelated brackets in the surrounding prose do not break parsing, as tests show.

items.title: extract_json_from_text uses raw_decode for embedded JSON
items.criterion: extract_json_from_text scans for the first valid JSON object or array using `json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode`. Text containing multiple {} blocks then yields the first valid one, as a test shows.

items.title: Config getters merge defaults into partial sections
items.criterion: get_generation_config, get_curate_config, get_vllm_config and the other getters merge user values over the defaults, so a partial section keeps unspecified defaults. Unit tests cover this.

items.title: ingest.process_file resolves output_dir from config when None
items.criterion: Passing output_dir=None resolves the configured parsed output path instead of raising TypeError from os.path.exists(None). A test covers direct library use.

items.title: Avoid filename collisions for URLs from the same domain
items.criterion: Non-YouTube URL output names include a sanitized path slug or a hash of the full URL, so two pages from one domain produce distinct files.

items.title: PPTParser must not duplicate slide titles
items.criterion: The title shape is skipped in the shapes loop, so each title appears once, and test_ppt_parse_success is updated to match.

items.title: YouTubeParser ImportError names pytubefix
items.criterion: The install hint says `pip install pytubefix youtube-transcript-api`, and the test match strings are updated.

items.title: Web curate form passes a quality threshold
items.criterion: The unused num_pairs field in CurateForm is replaced with a bounded threshold field, and its value is passed to curate_qa_pairs.

items.title: Validate create --type and numeric options early
items.criterion: Unknown --type values, num_pairs <= 0, chunk_size <= 0 and overlap outside [0, chunk_size) are rejected before any server check or LLM call. Rejection happens in the CLI through Typer constraints and in create.process_file for library callers.

items.title: Validate curate threshold range and positive batch sizes
items.criterion: Thresholds outside [1, 10] are rejected, and batch_size, inference batch and SDK_BATCH_SIZE values must be positive integers. Zero no longer causes a range() error.

items.title: COTGenerator.process_document: real verbose param, remove dead env round-trip
items.criterion: include_simple_steps is either used or removed, a proper verbose parameter is added and passed from create.py, and the no-op read-then-write of SDK_VERBOSE is deleted.

items.title: Remove redundant first file read in cot-enhance
items.criterion: The unused `read_json(file_path)` call in the cot-enhance branch is removed, and the misleading read_json helper is renamed if kept.

items.title: Remove or gate debug prints in config, client and create
items.criterion: Unconditional prints in load_config, get_llm_provider, LLMClient init and create.process_file are removed or moved to logger.debug, and the impossible WARNING branch is deleted.

items.title: Update DOCS.md to match the actual CLI and modules
items.criterion: DOCS.md drops references to core/cleanup.py, setup.py, data/cleaned and `create --threshold`. It documents --chunk-size, --chunk-overlap, --preview, cot-enhance and the curated paths.

items.title: Fix Getting Started link in issue template
items.criterion: The config.yml contact link points to use-cases/getting-started/README.md.

items.title: Remove committed .DS_Store files
items.criterion: Tracked .DS_Store files under use-cases are deleted and .DS_Store is listed in .gitignore.

items.title: Progress bars advance despite TaskID 0
items.criterion: Guards like `if progress_ctx and task:` become `is not None` checks, so the first task (id 0) updates.

items.title: parse_ratings must not silently return [] on one missing rating
items.criterion: A single array item lacking 'rating' no longer returns []. The function falls through to other methods or raises, so the caller's per-item fallback runs.

items.title: parse_ratings tries array before object extraction
items.criterion: A JSON array of rating objects is parsed as an array rather than failing because a `{...}` regex spans multiple elements. A test covers this.

items.title: parse_qa_pairs regex fallback fully decodes JSON escapes
items.criterion: Captured strings are decoded with json.loads, so \n, \\ and \uXXXX are unescaped. Errors are handled per pair.

items.title: Per-chunk pair counts round up to meet requested total
items.criterion: pairs_per_chunk in QAGenerator and examples_per_chunk in COTGenerator use math.ceil, so the total is not under-produced. The excess is truncated.

items.title: CoT single-call path caps output at num_examples
items.criterion: _generate_single_call slices results to num_examples and drops non-dict items.

items.title: cot-enhance keeps all conversations when flattening nested output
items.criterion: Nested lists are flattened only when the outer list has length 1. Otherwise the result is validated as a list of message dicts, with the original kept on mismatch.

items.title: Pass the full summary into QA generation prompt
items.criterion: generate_qa_pairs no longer truncates the summary to `summary[:100]`; it passes the full summary or a configurable limit.

items.title: Reject empty documents before LLM calls
items.criterion: Empty or whitespace-only documents raise a clear ValueError before summary or generation, so there is no division by zero on len(chunks). Tests cover the QA and CoT paths.

items.title: vLLM completion retries on JSON decode errors; fix backoff
items.criterion: _vllm_chat_completion also catches ValueError and JSON decode errors and retries. The backoff is made truly exponential, or the comment is corrected.

items.title: Reject unsupported LLM provider names
items.criterion: Providers other than 'vllm' and 'api-endpoint' raise a clear error in config, CLI and LLMClient instead of silently falling back to vLLM.

items.title: load_config requires a mapping YAML root
items.criterion: Empty or scalar YAML files raise a clear error instead of returning None or a scalar that fails later.

items.title: Remove logging.basicConfig call at library import
items.criterion: llm_client.py no longer configures root logging on import; any logging setup is done in the CLI.

items.title: Lazily import Flask server in CLI
items.criterion: run_server is imported inside the server command, so other commands work without Flask installed and without the server module's side effects.

items.title: Validate curation input schema up front
items.criterion: curate_qa_pairs checks for a dict root with a qa_pairs list of dicts that have question and answer fields. The error names the failing item index.

items.title: Do not silently write partial curation after inference failures
items.criterion: Batch or item rating failures are tracked. Curation either raises when items remain unrated or records them explicitly, and partial output is opt-in.

items.title: Check batch_completion response count matches requests
items.criterion: Generation and curation verify one response per request and retry or raise on a mismatch, rather than silently dropping chunks.

items.title: Directory preview works without LLM connectivity
items.criterion: In create and curate, --preview on a directory is handled before provider initialization and server checks. A test asserts that no HTTP request is made.

items.title: Single-file --preview must not process the file
items.criterion: --preview on a single file either exits nonzero or shows the planned operation without calling processing functions, as a test verifies.

items.title: Prevent output_name path traversal in ingest
items.criterion: A user-supplied output_name must be a basename, or must resolve inside output_dir. Paths like `../x` and absolute paths are rejected.

items.title: YouTube URL detection uses parsed hostnames
items.criterion: YouTube URLs are identified by the parsed hostname, such as youtube.com, youtu.be and subdomains, not by substring checks. Hosts like `youtube.com.evil.example` are not treated as YouTube.

items.title: Robust PDF URL detection beyond HEAD Content-Type
items.criterion: _check_pdf_url falls back to the URL suffix or a bounded GET when HEAD fails or omits Content-Type, and the status is checked before parsing.

items.title: Enforce upload size limit on web server
items.criterion: MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH is configured on the Flask app, and unsupported file types are rejected at upload.

items.title: Always clean up temporary web uploads
items.criterion: The ingest route uses a real temp file, deleted in a finally block, so parser failures do not leave uploads behind.

items.title: Stable configurable Flask secret key
items.criterion: The secret key is read from an environment variable or config, with an explicit development-only fallback, instead of a random value generated at import.

items.title: Write edited datasets atomically in web server
items.criterion: edit_item and delete_item write to a temp file and then call os.replace instead of overwriting in place.

items.title: to_hf_dataset builds columns from union of keys
items.criterion: Columns come from all items' keys, not just the first item's, with missing values filled.

items.title: Use .jsonl extension for ChatML output
items.criterion: Directory save-as and default CLI naming give newline-delimited ChatML output a .jsonl suffix.

items.title: VQA dataset loading accepts record lists and resolves splits
items.criterion: VQAGenerator.process_dataset uses Dataset.from_list for a JSON array of records and from_dict for a column mapping. It selects a split from a DatasetDict, choosing the sole split or requiring one when there are several.

items.title: VQAGenerator reads prompt from prompts section
items.criterion: transform looks up `prompts.vqa_reasoning`, falling back to a top-level prompt, instead of only reading the top-level 'prompt' key.

items.title: Expose vqa_add_reasoning in CLI help and directory processing
items.criterion: The create help lists vqa_add_reasoning, and process_directory_create handles its .json input.

items.title: Deduplicate OpenAI response content extraction
items.criterion: The duplicated response-extraction block in _openai_chat_completion and _process_message_async moves into one helper method used by both.

items.title: Factor shared record builders for HF and file save formats
items.criterion: The alpaca, ft and chatml record construction is shared between format_converter writers and the save_as HF branch, with no duplicated system prompts.

items.title: Single helper for directory previews built on get_supported_files
items.criterion: The repeated preview-printing block in cli.py is replaced by one helper. Directory stats derive from get_supported_files with sorted ordering.

items.title: Single-source package version and consistent publish workflow
items.criterion: __version__ derives from package metadata, or pyproject uses a dynamic version. publish.yml uses trusted publishing consistently instead of mixing it with twine credentials.

items.title: Add unit tests for parse_ratings and curate_qa_pairs
items.criterion: New tests cover parse_ratings for arrays, single objects, code-block wrapped input and malformed input. They also cover curate_qa_pairs batch rating, threshold filtering and the per-item fallback.

items.title: system-check API test asserts chat.completions.create
items.criterion: test_system_check_command_api_endpoint mocks and asserts `chat.completions.create` instead of models.list.

items.title: Test HTMLParser with real BeautifulSoup
items.criterion: test_html_parser runs real bs4 on HTML containing script and style tags and asserts they are removed.

items.title: Tests patch load_config where it is consumed
items.criterion: Fixtures patch the consumer module symbols (cli, context, generators) rather than utils.config.load_config only, so patches take effect.

items.title: Fix toolcall.py duplicate return and hardcoded dataset path
items.criterion: The dead second return is removed and custom_dataset accepts dataset_path as a parameter.

items.title: CI smoke-tests the installed CLI
items.criterion: The CI test step runs `synthetic-data-kit system-check` and `synthetic-data-kit --help` (hyphenated entry point) before pytest.

items.title: Remove committed example outputs and ignore generated data
items.criterion: Committed example_output artifacts, including test_write.json and the Lance files, are deleted. .gitignore covers data/, example_output and .venv-ci/.

items.title: Fix cot_tools_config.yaml provider section and YAML indentation
items.criterion: The use-case config adds `llm.provider` and an api-endpoint section, and fixes the mis-indented multiline cot_enhancement prompt so it parses correctly.

items.title: PDF parser type hints compatible with older Python
items.criterion: PDFParser.parse is annotated with typing.List[Dict[str, Any]] instead of `list[dict[str, any]]`.

items.title: Backward-compat tests check process_file keyword arguments
items.criterion: The ingest tests assert output_dir and output_name via call kwargs rather than positional indices.

items.title: Document multimodal usage and max_retries in README
items.criterion: The README describes Lance-based ingest, `--multimodal` and `--type multimodal-qa`, and includes max_retries in the api-endpoint config example.
